92: Where there is another exit - when one takes the Torah scroll through its exit, whoever wants to go out through a different exit may do so, even if the Torah scroll has not yet gone out. If there is not another exit, it is proper that the Torah scroll exit first, and one should not go out through the exit before the Torah scroll.
Bar Ahina explained to me - a sage by the name of bar Ahina explained to me: he made me understand the reason for the matter.
